note: DIRECTION CHANGE, round 3. The client played the working build and found it incoherent: an amber instruction, a red fire line, a narrator line and an open detail card on screen at once, three of them paraphrasing each other, with the open card describing a different failure than the one burning. The answer is not less information but MORE INFORMATION EMBODIED IN THE WORLD. AESTHETIC.md is now the governing law: CIVIC NATURALISM, two registers — the colony is human and tactile, the instrumentation is spare and diagrammatic. Rigor is not discarded, it is moved out of the foreground. The new law, and the eleventh scored criterion, is one question: WHAT FACT DOES THIS ALLOW ME NOT TO WRITE? Retired: the black-and-white palette, the no-border-radius ban, the permanent 28-cell table, the permanent six-button tool bar. Kept: one self-contained file, all 28 real detectors, no emoji, IBM Plex Mono, and the outbreak loop, whose mechanics the client called good — only its presentation changes. The chain was red thing, code, sentence, table, concept, answer. It becomes incident, recognition, intervention.

pieces.name: NEST — the colony as the dashboard
pieces.judged: L11 the Depiction Law above all. Traffic, sameness, perception, possession and weather must be READABLE AS BEHAVIOUR. Seven idle ants visibly wander rather than reading idle:7. Congestion is a crowd at a doorway. History is wear on the architecture. Lineage is trail pattern. Ants get gait, posture and hesitation so a player says 'why are all five carrying the same thing' unprompted.

pieces.name: INCIDENT — one paper tag, one action, nothing else
pieces.judged: incident then recognition then intervention. At most ONE message on screen ever. No taxonomy code during play. The six institutions become folk technology whose silhouette teaches its function: meeting stone, branching seed, tally wall, lantern, bell, threshold.

pieces.name: GUIDE — the naturalist's collection
pieces.judged: The 28-cell matrix becomes collectible plates, blank until witnessed, drawn when seen, stamped when answered. Never openable during a decision. Taxonomy as knowledge you discovered about a species, not documentation shipped with the software.

pieces.name: SHELL — civic naturalism, and the abolished HUD
pieces.judged: The material/signal palette split. Quiet crown, colony-owned centre, bottom that is ABSENT unless there is a decision. Every string must have survived the Depiction Law.

pieces.name: WORLD — 28 detectors, trade-offs, balance
pieces.judged: audit all 28 fire with working counters; section-15 trade-offs proven; misses must COST; balance measured through the live loop; and every element needs a body — a depictable behaviour the renderer can show without a caption

pieces.name: TEACH — the episode sequence
pieces.judged: L1 one idea at a time, L2 play first name second, L8 hands on the game within five seconds, L6 the A/B re-run, L9 the sandbox is the reward
